payload.title: What run practice ends a budget-bound build run on a reviewed final candidate, without endless review?
payload.body: Separating scenarios: S1 (cut after R-8JQPWG: one Result left, a fix commit pending) and S2 (cut after R-JHBCWS: reviews that found no defect still led to commits). Replay each from the cut with 3 Sonnet trials per candidate and for the base, and compare how each run ends, how many fresh reviews it launches and what it costs. Each rival is a scratch patch; the Goal body pins the base.

why: The question of issue #141, held as rival Hypotheses for the run to test.

payload.title: H-one-experiment: a candidate's review is part of its gate Experiment
payload.body: One Experiment and one Result carry the gate's verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Result again.

why: A rival of issue #141 named by the owner, to be tested from the cuts.

payload.title: H-name-at-stop: the stop checkpoint names each candidate without a review
payload.body: Keep a review as its own Experiment; the stop checkpoint names every candidate with no review, so the gap is visible. Also tested combined with each single that fails line 1 alone.

why: A rival of issue #141 named by the owner, to be tested from the cuts.

payload.title: H-reserve-last: with one Result left the run reviews the current candidate, not another fix
payload.body: The run stops with the review's findings recorded as limits, not with a new commit.

why: A rival of issue #141 named by the owner, to be tested from the cuts.

payload.title: H-raise-budget: the default of --experiments rises to fit a gate and a review per candidate
payload.body: A scratch change to prompt.go's default (for example 7). Run 2 argues against it: each review so far led to a new commit.

why: A rival of issue #141 named by the owner, to be tested from the cuts.

payload.title: H-probe-closes: a case the run's own probe passed on the candidate is closed in the review's Result, not a limit
payload.body: A limit stays for a case no check ran or one the candidate fails. Run 3's N1 and P1 would close on 3cfd08d with no further commit.

why: A rival of issue #141 named by the owner, to be tested from the cuts.

payload.title: H-whole-candidate: the review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base
payload.body: The owner expects it to lose on cost, since one cumulative review is large; it is tested anyway.

why: A rival of issue #141 named by the owner, to be tested from the cuts.

payload.title: H-review-owed: hyp status OWED lists a review for a candidate that has none
payload.body: A scratch hyp binary derives the owed review from the log. A gate and a review look alike (--recipe none --rubric reading); if the log cannot tell them apart without a new stored field, the run states the field and refers it, and adds none.

why: A rival of issue #141 named by the owner, to be tested from the cuts.

payload.summary: Grill done: 5 lines written by owner-standin, 7 rivals under Q-QJXJT3, issue #141 linked. The run tests from the cuts S1 and S2, staged: base, singles, then H-name-at-stop combinations. Out-of-Goal: landing the winner is a build Goal the owner adds after the select; a derived review mark may need a stored field and is referred, not added.
